```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Library Imports
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(performance)
```

# Data Imports
```{r}
pa_plot_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/cleaned_data/prop_adair_plot_level.csv") %>% 
        mutate(trial="pa")
pp_plot_data <- read.csv("../../data/processed/cleaned_data/prop_picos_plot_level.csv") %>% 
        mutate(trial="pp")

combined_data = rbind(pa_plot_data, pp_plot_data) %>% 
        dplyr::select(trial, everything())

factor_cols <- c('trial', 'rs', 'prop_type', 'block')
combined_data[,factor_cols] <- lapply(combined_data[,factor_cols], factor)
```

# qPCR Modeling
```{r}
pcr_data <- combined_data[complete.cases(combined_data),]
pcr_mm <- lmer(hlb_ct_adj ~ rs * prop_type + (1|trial/block), data=pcr_data) # Random intercept for block nested in trial
pcr_aov <- anova(pcr_mm)
pcr_emm <- emmeans(pcr_mm, c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))
pcr_rs_cld <- cld(pcr_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
pcr_prop_cld <- cld(pcr_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
pcr_rsprop_cld <- cld(pcr_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
summary(pcr_mm)

as.data.frame(VarCorr(pcr_mm))
icc(pcr_mm)
```

# Nutrient Models Prop Adair
```{r prop_adair nutrient mixed models}
# nitrogen
n_mm <- lmer(n_per ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pa_plot_data)
n_aov <- anova(n_mm)
n_emm <- emmeans(n_mm, c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))

n_rs_cld <- cld(n_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
n_prop_cld <- cld(n_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
n_rsprop_cld <- cld(n_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)

# manganese
mn_mm <- lmer(mn_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pa_plot_data)
mn_aov <- anova(mn_mm)
mn_emm <- emmeans(mn_mm, c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))

mn_prop_cld <- cld(mn_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)

fe_mm <- lmer(fe_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pa_plot_data)
fe_aov <- anova(fe_mm)
fe_emm <- emmeans(fe_mm, c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))

fe_rs_cld <- cld(fe_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
fe_prop_cld <- cld(fe_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
fe_rsprop_cld <- cld(fe_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)

# copper
cu_mm <- lmer(cu_ppm ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=pa_plot_data)
cu_aov <- anova(cu_mm)
cu_emm <- emmeans(cu_mm, c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs:prop_type))

cu_rs_cld <- cld(cu_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
cu_prop_cld <- cld(cu_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)
cu_rsprop_cld <- cld(cu_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters=letters, decreasing=TRUE)

aov_list <- list(n_aov, p_aov, k_aov, mg_aov, ca_aov, s_aov, b_aov, zn_aov, mn_aov, fe_aov, cu_aov)

rs_cld_list <- list(n_rs_cld, p_rs_cld, k_rs_cld, mg_rs_cld, ca_rs_cld, s_rs_cld, b_rs_cld, zn_rs_cld, mn_rs_cld, fe_rs_cld, cu_rs_cld)

prop_cld_list <- list(n_prop_cld, p_prop_cld, k_prop_cld, mg_prop_cld, ca_prop_cld, s_prop_cld, b_prop_cld, zn_prop_cld, mn_prop_cld, fe_prop_cld, cu_prop_cld)

rsprop_cld_list <- list(n_rsprop_cld, p_rsprop_cld, k_rsprop_cld, mg_rsprop_cld, ca_rsprop_cld, s_rsprop_cld, b_rsprop_cld, zn_rsprop_cld, mn_rsprop_cld, fe_rsprop_cld, cu_rsprop_cld)

name_vec = c('nitrogen', 'phosphorus', 'potassium', 'magnesium', 'calcium',
             'sulphur', 'boron', 'zinc', 'manganese', 'iron', 'copper')

pa_rs_df <- data.frame('rs' = c('US-1516', 'US-812', 'US-897', 'US-942'))
pa_rs_aov <- c('p-value')

pa_prop_df <- data.frame('prop_type' = c('ct', 'mpg', 'sd'))
pa_prop_aov <- c('p-value')

pa_rsprop_df <- data.frame('rs' = rep(c('US-1516', 'US-812', 'US-897', 'US-942'), each=3),
                           'prop_type' = rep(c('ct', 'mpg', 'sd'), times=4))
pa_rsprop_aov <- c('p-value', ' ')

for (i in 1:length(rs_cld_list)) {

        tmp <- data.frame(rs_cld_list[[i]]) %>% 
                mutate(mean_letter = paste(sprintf("%.4f", emmean), trimws(.group, 'both'), sep=' '))
        pa_rs_df <- pa_rs_df %>%
                left_join(tmp[,c(1, 8)], by='rs')
        p_value <- aov_list[[i]]$"Pr(>F)"[1]
        pa_rs_aov <- c(pa_rs_aov, round(p_value, 6))

        
        tmp <- data.frame(prop_cld_list[[i]]) %>% 
                mutate(mean_letter = paste(sprintf("%.4f", emmean), trimws(.group, 'both'), sep=' '))
        pa_prop_df <- pa_prop_df %>%
                left_join(tmp[,c(1, 8)], by='prop_type')
        p_value <- aov_list[[i]]$"Pr(>F)"[2]
        pa_prop_aov <- c(pa_prop_aov, sprintf("%.4f", p_value))
        
        
        tmp <- data.frame(rsprop_cld_list[[i]]) %>% 
                mutate(mean_letter = paste(sprintf("%.4f", emmean), trimws(.group, 'both'), sep=' '))
        pa_rsprop_df <- pa_rsprop_df %>%
                left_join(tmp[,c(1, 2, 9)], by=c('rs', 'prop_type'))
        p_value <- aov_list[[i]]$"Pr(>F)"[3]
        pa_rsprop_aov <- c(pa_rsprop_aov, sprintf("%.4f", p_value))
        
}
colnames(pa_rs_df)[2:12] <- name_vec
colnames(pa_prop_df)[2:12] <- name_vec
colnames(pa_rsprop_df)[3:13] <- name_vec

pa_rs_df <- rbind(pa_rs_df, pa_rs_aov)
pa_prop_df <- rbind(pa_prop_df, pa_prop_aov)
pa_rsprop_df <- rbind(pa_rsprop_df, pa_rsprop_aov)


mm_vec <- c(n_mm, p_mm, k_mm, mg_mm, ca_mm, s_mm, b_mm, zn_mm, mn_mm, fe_mm, cu_mm)
for (mm in mm_vec) {
        vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mm))
        print(vc)
}
as.data.frame(VarCorr(pcr_mm))
```
